action: Perform a bounded native AWS CloudFormation calibration exclusively in account 000000000000, us-east-1, as arn:aws:iam::000000000000:user/Delegated. Verify STS identity before writes and force public service endpoints with all configured endpoint overrides disabled. Create at most one unique exact-owned tagged Python Lambda function (never invoke; reserved concurrency zero as additional safeguard), one Lambda-trust execution role with only secretsmanager:GetSecretValue on the exact-owned secret ARN, and one unique tagged authentication secret containing probe-only dummy SASL credentials. Create one unique owned CFN stack for AWS::Lambda::EventSourceMapping with Enabled=false, SelfManagedEventSource.Endpoints.KafkaBootstrapServers=[<unique>.invalid:9092], a unique topic/group, SASL_SCRAM_512_AUTH pointing exclusively at the owned secret and StartingPosition=LATEST. No real broker, paid MSK/MQ/DocumentDB, VPC/network resources, public policies, KMS key or invocations. Keep every mapping disabled including replacements. Read public registry/schema and primary AWS docs. If create succeeds, perform at most 18 CFN updates to calibrate batch/window/filter/tag set and removal, group/topic updates/removal, owned secret SourceAccessConfigurations removal/re-add/change to another auth type with same dummy secret if admissible, and StartingPosition/timestamp/source endpoint replacement using only the same reserved .invalid namespace. Wait at most 240 seconds per stack operation and 120 per resource; abort workflow on unexpected status/state or admission prerequisites. Preverify unique role/function/secret/stack names absent, durably save exact ownership before mutation, retain full requests/native errors/responses/models/source URLs with AWS credential redaction. Always cleanup exact observed mapping UUIDs, owned stack, function, role/policy and force-delete own dummy secret; verify absent or explicitly retain deleted-stack native history. Cleanup-only recovery uses same identity/ownership guards. Stop rather than widening permissions/resources if native admission requires additional broker/network prerequisites.
